demo.title: papertrade-session.txt
demo.code:
You:   long BTC 100x with $150 on papertrade
Bankr: Long BTC on Papertrade (real USDC): $150 margin at 100x = $15,000
       position. Entry ~$112,840, liquidation ~$111,770 (-0.95%).
       No open fee, no funding; a win pays a 2% fee plus an impact
       haircut. Funded with ~152.40 USDC from Base (1 USDC first-time
       activation). A liquidation loses the whole $150. Reply yes to place it.
You:   yes
Bankr: Opened a long on BTC at 100x. Margin $150, entry $112,846,
       liquidation $111,774. Ask me to close it any time.

— later —
You:   close my papertrade BTC and stake the PAPER
Bankr: Closed at -$40. That loss minted PAPER, now staked; claimed
       rewards land in your Papertrade balance as USDC.

setup: Install the skill with the button below — Bankr's Papertrade tools work without it; the skill adds the venue's rules
Hold USDC on Base, Arbitrum, Polygon or Ethereum in your Bankr wallet (first deposit 11.20 USDC or more)
Say: "long BTC 100x with $150 on papertrade" — you get a preview with the liquidation price, then reply yes
Papertrade is real money: a liquidation loses the full margin, and Bankr caps leverage at 100x
